Kiro's Open VSX Extension Support Explained

Your favorite VS Code extensions? Probably still work.
Kiro supports Open VSX, the open extension marketplace.
Most popular extensions install the same way they did in VS Code.
You don't lose your toolchain switching to Kiro.
